stem: A tailor in Karachi uses 2.5 meters of cloth to make one kurta. What is the greatest number of complete kurtas the tailor can make from 42 meters of cloth?
solution: Only complete kurtas count, so round down: 16 kurtas (16 kurtas use 40 meters; 17 would need 42.5 meters).
verify:
n = floor(Rational(42) / Rational('2.5'))
assert n == 16 and n * Rational('2.5') <= 42 < (n + 1) * Rational('2.5')
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == n
